# Istoselidakias

> Istoselidakias is a Greek studio that builds websites and e-shops, and runs social media, video, Google Ads and AI chatbots for businesses all over Greece. Phone: +30 211 218 6538. Prices are fixed and listed below.

## Services

- [Websites](https://istoselidakias.gr/#paketa): Basic package 290 € one-off (79 € a year from the 2nd year); no monthly subscription.
- [E-shop and online booking](https://istoselidakias.gr/kataskevi-eshop): 450 € one-off (190 € a year from the 2nd year), with cart, card or cash-on-delivery payment and an admin panel. Supplier stock sync 150 € + 10 € a month.
- [Social media management](https://istoselidakias.gr/social-media): Facebook and Instagram. 8 posts 120 €, 12 posts with 2 reels 170 €, 20 posts with 4 reels 250 € a month; no commitment.
- [Video and animation](https://istoselidakias.gr/video): reel up to 30 s 90 €, video up to 60 s with professional voice over 180 €, custom animation 290 €.
- [AI chatbot and digital front desk](https://istoselidakias.gr/chatbot): chatbot 290 € + 19 € a month; digital front desk that books appointments 490 € + 39 € a month; company bot from 690 € + 49 € a month; automations from 150 €.
- [Google Ads](https://istoselidakias.gr/google-ads): setup 120 €, management 40 € a month (ad spend paid to Google). Facebook and Instagram ads: same prices.
